messages:
marta (solutions): quick heads-up — FinSecure POC hitting intermittent streaming failures behind corporate proxy. socket hang ups + NGHTTP2 errors + occasional 504s and 429s during retries. they use Node TS sdk (node 18) and a forward proxy.

alex (sales): are there request ids / logs? streaming or non-streaming?

marta (solutions): streaming. log excerpt from them: 
```
2026-03-20T17:05:12Z ERROR stream failed: ERR_HTTP2_STREAM_ERROR code=NGHTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR requestId=rq_0a1b2c3d
2026-03-20T17:05:12Z WARN retrying request attempt=1 after 120ms
2026-03-20T17:05:14Z ERROR socket hang up during data frame write
2026-03-20T17:06:02Z ERROR http status=504 upstream_response_time=58.2s requestId=rq_0a1b2c3d
```

ben (eng-infra): likely two things: http/2 + proxy interception causing NGHTTP2 errors, and proxy idle/timeout dropping long-lived streams. did proxy MITM or use CONNECT?

luis (sdks): recommend forcing HTTP/1.1, enabling keepAlive, lowering socket pool. sample Node config: 
```
import HttpsProxyAgent from 'https-proxy-agent';
const agent = new HttpsProxyAgent({ keepAlive:true, maxSockets:8, timeout:60000 });
const client = new Redwood({ agent, timeoutMs:120000, maxRetries:3, forceHttp1:true });
await client.stream({ model:'gpt-open-2', input:'hello' });
```

Also quick curl to repro from behind proxy: 
```
curl -v -x http://corp-proxy:8080 --no-http2 -H "Connection: keep-alive" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=gpt-open-2' -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```

ben (eng-infra): if proxy re-signs TLS, they must trust proxy CA or use CONNECT. proxy timeouts -> 504 after ~60s suggests idle timeout. short-term: reduce chunk interval or send small heartbeats.

luis (sdks): enable SDK debug (REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1) and capture X-Request-Id for correlation. for retries, use { maxRetries:2, baseDelayMs:200, maxDelayMs:2000, jitter:true } to avoid amplifying load.

marta (solutions): customer also asked: can we provide a Dedicated eval to avoid proxy, and they need SOC2 answers.

alex (sales): we can offer 30-day Dedicated trial for POC. cc security for SOC2.

security-bot: forwarding SOC2/security pack to FinSecure. will review questionnaire and ping if infra logs needed. ETA EOD tomorrow.

ben (eng-infra): we can provision a short-lived Dedicated pool in their region to rule out proxy.

marta (solutions): plan: 1) send Node + curl + debug env to FinSecure and ask for request ids 2) suggest force-http1, keepAlive, reduce pool, retry tuning, heartbeat shim 3) offer Dedicated trial 4) security will handle SOC2. i'll update after they run tests.

luis (sdks): if NGHTTP2 persists after forcing http1, send SDK debug and we'll triage client parsing.

ben (eng-infra): optional: reduce concurrency or use per-connection pings from app to keep proxy sessions alive.

marta (solutions): thanks all — i'll follow up. :thumbsup:
